test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

She said to me, “I saw this old man long ago.”

options.text: She told me that she had seen that old man long before.
She told to me that she had seen that old man long before.
She said to me that she had seen that old man long ago.
She said me that she had seen this old man long ago.

solution:
The correct answer is **'She told me that she had seen that old man long before.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has an object. Hence, 'said to' will be changed into** 'told'. **
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added.
 
• '**I**' will be changed into '**she**' because the** first person pronouns** are changed according to the subject of the **reporting verb.**
 
• V2 will be changed into 'had + V3'. (simple past tense changes into past perfect tense)
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.

 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ *She told me that she had seen that old man long before.*
